online_field_state_policy.eligible_observations: Only same-session qualifying attempts strictly earlier than the prediction time.
online_field_state_policy.entry_exclusion: Current driver's earlier observations are excluded from the common field mean.
online_field_state_policy.same_timestamp_policy: Attempts at the same timestamp are not allowed to inform one another.
online_field_state_policy.low_support_policy: When n=0, prediction uses the frozen cross-year prior. For n>0, current-session field evidence is partially pooled toward that prior through shrinkage k.

thermal_role: Auxiliary physical/context evidence and ablation only. Do not treat as a stable universal qualifying-speed coefficient.
latent_window_interpretation: The selected online session-calibration posterior is the operational estimate of current field performance state. A more complex Kalman latent process was tested but did not earn promotion.
uncertainty_policy_for_next_phase: Prediction uncertainty must include residual/run noise and calibration uncertainty; uncertainty should shrink as current-session field evidence accumulates.
